qualification_scope: Owner-authorized Community HACS v0.1.8 TEST source candidate. One native Home Assistant Config Entry; all ongoing configuration and commissioning use typed Controller, ChargeableAsset and Charger fields solely in the five-tab MultiCharge dashboard, with no free-text YAML/JSON editor, external templates/packages, HA Options configuration detour or duplicate settings owner. Direct vehicle assignment, charging goals, modes, safe STOP, native source selection, protected electrical/physical qualification, stable HA Devices/Entities and Recorder. Retains guarded planner/executor and a locally bundled MIT ApexCharts 3.49.1 measured/proposed/accepted/indicative chart with separately labelled source-qualified price axis. Release requires exact-head development CI, squash-merged exact main source CI, isolated Home Assistant 2026.11.2 runtime, responsive real Chromium source-based UX and verified public HACS zip/checksum. This is a TEST for further site qualification, never STABLE or automatic physical cutover.
limitations: Wessels Safari/iPad after upgrade, actual native vendor cable/SoC/current/power states and real physical START/STOP/amp readback, site phase/circuit and battery constraints, provider tariff observations and rollback remain NOT_RUN until field acceptance. Foundation Mobility export is NOT_CAPTURED; Peblar phase-current and Utility Plug cable telemetry not established. Existing EV Smart Charging keeps exclusive physical command ownership; MultiCharge remains external owner at Wessels until separately commissioned. Historical file-owned YAML/JSON imports remain read-only for backwards compatibility; no live dashboard text-editor write path. Do not infer Feature Complete or field acceptance from published HACS TEST.
